title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Stolen Spotlight

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen wins the spring Tenno Sho. She ran earnestly in order to bring the illustrious spring plaque home to the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Mejiro Palmer runs for her own freedom… She begins to wonder if that is really something to be proud of. Or is she just being selfish?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is the spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen. Will Mejiro Palmer be able to be her true self at a festival race the fans go crazy for?
